prompts.strategy_selector: Call strategy_brief() FIRST — it contains the SeriesProfile and the full candidate library. Use series_profile fields to justify every selection. Return ONLY JSON per the output schema. No markdown, no explanation.

series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend direction with moderate strength and present seasonality. High RMSE spread and concept drift suggest using dynamic error-weighted combination to adapt to changing model performance.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → dynamic error weighting adapts to changing model performance (Gaillard & Goude 2015)
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rmse_spread_ratio=2.207 AND combination_recommendation.regularization=high → inverse RMSE weights with shrinkage (0.35) to handle model heterogeneity (Hansen et al. 2011)
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → per-horizon selection captures differentiated model performance across forecast horizons (Timmermann 2006)

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.avoid=ridge_stacking AND n_windows=2 → ridge overfits with few validation windows (Genre et al. 2013)
